Pyodide 314.0.7 — Python 3.14.2 / WebAssembly

These unmodified core files are self-hosted by Код 1430.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v314.0.7/full/
Official project: https://pyodide.org/
Deployment documentation: https://pyodide.org/en/stable/usage/downloading-and-deploying.html

Core files:
pyodide.mjs
pyodide.asm.mjs
pyodide.asm.wasm
python_stdlib.zip
pyodide-lock.json

No third-party Python packages are loaded by the application.
LICENSE is the Pyodide license; PYTHON-LICENSE is the CPython license.
The runtime must be served over HTTP(S), e.g. GitHub Pages. Opening index.html
through a file:// URL cannot start module workers.
